mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_date AS createDate, a.update_by AS updateBy, a.update_date AS updateDate, a.remarks, a.status, a.alarm_name AS alarmName, a.alarm_key AS alarmKey, a.enable_alarm AS enableAlarm, a.need_confirm AS needConfirm, a.dialog_position AS dialogPosition FROM swm_alarm_config a WHERE a.alarm_key = #{alarmKey} AND a.status = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_date AS createDate, a.update_by AS updateBy, a.update_date AS updateDate, a.remarks, a.status, a.alarm_name AS alarmName, a.alarm_key AS alarmKey, a.enable_alarm AS enableAlarm, a.need_confirm AS needConfirm, a.dialog_position AS dialogPosition FROM swm_alarm_config a WHERE a.status = '0' AND a.enable_alarm = 1 ORDER BY a.alarm_key

SELECT a.id, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_date AS createDate, a.update_by AS updateBy, a.update_date AS updateDate, a.remarks, a.status, a.alarm_name AS alarmName, a.alarm_key AS alarmKey, a.enable_alarm AS enableAlarm, a.need_confirm AS needConfirm, a.dialog_position AS dialogPosition FROM swm_alarm_config a WHERE a.status = '0' AND a.enable_alarm = 1 AND a.need_confirm = 1 ORDER BY a.alarm_key
mapper.update: UPDATE swm_alarm_config SET alarm_name = #{alarmName}, alarm_key = #{alarmKey}, enable_alarm = #{enableAlarm}, need_confirm = #{needConfirm}, dialog_position = #{dialogPosition}, is_send_zjt = #{isSendZjt}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_date = #{updateDate} WHERE id = #{id}
